_about: EXPERIMENTAL marks for destructive steps (ask --mark-destructive). applies: 'command' = lines of a code block and inline code; 'prose' = running text; 'any' = both. 'unless' (regex, optional): the step is not listed when the command line or the sentence also matches it. 'needs_prose' (regex, optional): in running text the sentence must contain it before the match (a verb that recommends), so a diagnosis that merely states a value is not marked. A pattern never fires on a key's name alone: it needs the value, the verb or the command.
